title: Customer Success Manager
summary: Customer success managers look after a group of customers who already pay for a software product, making sure they use it well, renew their contracts and buy more over time. They sit in the customer success team next to sales and support and are measured on retention, renewals and account growth.
dailyDuties: Check account health and usage for your customers
Run onboarding check-ins and training calls
Hold quarterly business reviews with customer leaders
Plan renewals and spot upsell chances
Raise customer problems with product and support teams
Update account notes and renewal dates in the CRM

skills.expectation: Own renewals, cut churn and grow accounts through upsell
Run onboarding check-ins, health reviews and quarterly business reviews
Explain the product's value clearly to users and executives
Work across sales, product and support for each customer
Keep accounts, renewals and notes up to date in a CRM
Find why an account is unhappy and fix it
Track usage and account health in spreadsheets
Help new customers set up the product
Follow open tickets for your accounts
Demo new features to existing customers
Help customers get value from AI features
